instances.name: R_AGTX0
instances.vocabulary: Stock FSP 5.9 aggregate AGTX spelling for the identical AGT16 instance. No AGTW or AGT32 hardware is implied.

instances.name: R_AGTX1
instances.vocabulary: Stock FSP 5.9 aggregate AGTX spelling for the identical AGT16 instance.

differences.reason: Only AGT16 channels0/1 exist. Stock runtime AGT32 ternaries and AGTIOSEL_ALT references must be preprocessor-gated by BSP_FEATURE_AGT_REGISTER_TYPE (legacy 0, AGT16-only layout 1), independently of channel counts, so legacy zero-AGTW devices retain their original runtime branches. No absent AGT32 or ALT storage is supplied. AGTIOSEL contains TIES only; SEL is reserved.

WUPEN is the canonical FSP 5.9 name of the first 32-bit wake-enable bank, documented as WUPEN0 on RA8P1 at CPU-local ICU+0x1A0. A same-storage WUPEN view preserves only target fields; WUPEN1 remains independent. Parent owns target wake-source/event enums. No WUPEN2, SBYEDCR, SNZCR, SOPCCR, FOCOSCR or ICLKSCR is invented.

Canonical LVD1/2 and native PVD1/2 views name identical target storage and meanings. PVD4/5 remain native reset-only views: CR0.RE is bit0, with no RI/RN fields or PVD3. PVD4/5 FCR omitted pending resolution: HM8.2.9 prints 0xB2C+4*(n-1), n=4,5, which conflicts with the apparent indexing origin and surrounding register map; no guessed offset is published.
All target native ports here are 32-bit. Do not invent split16 SD_ARG1 or SD_BUF width/layout expected by older SDHI versions; select the real target register-access capability.
